info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Capital Markets Data Retrieval API
info.description: The Capital Markets Data Retrieval API provides access to essential data and analytics related to wholesale trading in capital markets. Utilizing this API, users can retrieve specific information based on dynamic parameters, enabling financial analysts and traders to make informed decisions. Typical consumers include financial institutions, investment firms, and trading platforms looking to enhance their market insights. This streamlined access to capital markets data supports real-time analysis and improves operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve resource RES-100045 from Capital Markets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about the resource identified by RES-100045 within the Capital Markets of the wholesale trading sector. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to access this resource.
